besluite.rede: The two short sentences already read clearly after 'Drie dinge'; the colon only merges them into one 22-word sentence, longer than any other in this Grade 4 lesson.

besluite.fout: 'is rustig met diere' copies English 'is calm with animals'.
besluite.rede: 'hanteer diere rustig' is the natural Afrikaans for the same strength and fits the dog-training example that follows.

besluite.fout: A bare 'almal' first reads as 'all people' rather than the strengths, because 'sterkpunt' is singular.
besluite.rede: The fault is real, but the proposed 'hulle' can point to 'mense' just as easily, so the writer needs a different fix that names the strengths.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two main clauses ('Die kind ... is' and 'jy teken').
besluite.rede: Each clause has its own subject and verb, so AWS 2017 requires the comma before 'en'.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two main clauses ('Ayanda hou' and 'sy praat').
besluite.rede: Each clause has its own subject and verb, so AWS 2017 requires the comma before 'en'.

besluite.fout: 'By' is the looser preposition for an event day.
besluite.rede: 'Op die skool se voorleesdag' is the idiomatic form for a day, and the time and place stay the same.

besluite.fout: 'gelees' is imprecise for reading aloud to a listening class.
besluite.rede: 'voorgelees' is the exact verb for what the paragraph already shows (she stood up and the class listened), and it adds no new fact.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two main clauses ('Die klas het' and 'die juffrou het').
besluite.rede: Each clause has its own subject and verb, so AWS 2017 requires the comma before 'en'.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two main clauses ('werk Sipho' and 'hy maak').
besluite.rede: This is only a comma, so the home example stays an exciting experience and does not become an achievement.

besluite.fout: 'binne lyk' is an incomplete form of the fixed expression 'van binne lyk'.
besluite.rede: This fixes the expression and does not change what Sipho did, so the home example stays an experience, not an achievement.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two main clauses ('Neo hardloop' and 'hy wen').
besluite.rede: Each clause has its own subject and verb, so AWS 2017 requires the comma before 'en'.

besluite.fout: 'By' is the looser preposition for an event day.
besluite.rede: 'Op die sportdag' is the idiomatic form, matches change 6, and leaves the time and event the same.
'laaste gekom' is the natural Afrikaans for a race result, with the same meaning.

besluite.fout: 'gedraf' (jogged) sits awkwardly beside 'net so vinnig gehardloop' in the same sentence.
besluite.rede: The clash is real, but the proposal drops what Neo did and adds 'soos altyd', a new claim, so the writer should fix it instead.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two main clauses ('Sy teken' and 'sy kyk').
besluite.rede: Each clause has its own subject and verb, so AWS 2017 requires the comma before 'en'.
Putting the relative clause after the particle 'in' is normal Afrikaans, and fronting the object makes the sentence harder for a Grade 4 reader.
